test: Array callback regressions > reduce and reduceRight reject arrays containing only holes
code:
const values = []
        values[2] = 1
        values.pop()
        let left
        let right
        try { values.reduce((a, b) => a + b) } catch (error) { left = error.name }
        try { values.reduceRight((a, b) => a + b) } catch (error) { right = error.name }
        return [left, right]
